title: Arrest Of One King Chien Ming

page_data.en:
TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT
No. 1441/2 DATED 31.7.38.
8667
Subject:- Arrest of one King Chien Ming.
On July 23, the Crime Branch arrested at No. 1, Lane
36, Rue Massenet, one King Chien Ming (金鑑明), aged 30, a
"doctor" without diploma. A parcel of documents was seized at
his home.
Handed over to the Political Section, King underwent
interrogation (see appendix), a resume of which is as follows:-
Since the commencement of the Sino-Japanese hostilities,
King has participated in the activities of National Salvation
Cultural Circles' elements, and since the dissolution of this
organization, has worked on behalf of various publications, one
of which, "Unity", has been edited in Shanghai by members of the
above mentioned Circles.
Among the documents seized, the following are note-
worthy:-
1) Letter from one Zao Yen (鮑言), in which the latter
attempts to justify the activities of the Trotsky Group, accused
of treason by the ~~Chinese Communist Party (Stalin Group)~~. This
letter is purely ideological in character.
2) List of leading members of the "Mutual Aid Society of
Residents of various Shanghai alleyways". (上海里弄住戶互助會).
From enquiries made, it seems that this Society was
formed at the beginning of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, but
was dissolved after the Chinese troops had abandoned Shanghai.
Of the 18 responsible members of the Society residing in the
French Concession, 15 have left for the interior. The remaining
three who continue to live in the Concession :-
1. Huang Tseng Ming (黃正明), 12 Tseng Fo Li, Route Prelupt.
2. Hsieh Kung Chian (謝公善), 85 Fu Ka Lung, Ave. Dubail.
3. Hu Keng Tang (胡慶塘), 14 Chung Foh Li, Boulevard de
Montigny.
are at present concerned in no political activities. However,
observation is being carried out to verify their activities.
page_data.zh:
法国警察报告译文
第 1441/2 号，日期 1938年7月31日。
8667
主题：逮捕金鑑明一名。
7月23日，刑事科在马斯南路（Rue Massenet）36弄1号逮捕了30岁的无执照“医生”金鑑明（King Chien Ming）。在其家中搜获文件一包。
移交政治科后，金接受了审讯（见附录），摘要如下：
自中日战事爆发以来，金参与了救亡文化界分子的活动；在该组织解散后，他为各种刊物工作，其中一种名为《团结》的刊物，由上述文化界成员在上海编辑。
在搜获的文件中，以下值得注意：
1) 鮑言（Zao Yen）的一封信，信中试图为托洛茨基派团体的活动辩护，该团体被 ~~中国共产党（斯大林派）~~ 指控为叛国。此信纯属意识形态性质。
2) “上海里弄住户互助会”主要成员名单。
经查询，该会似乎是在中日战事初期成立的，但在中国军队撤离上海后解散。居住在法租界的18名该会负责人中，有15人已前往内地。其余三人继续居住在租界内：
1. 黃正明（Huang Tseng Ming），普鲁特路（Route Prelupt）曾福里12号。
2. 謝公善（Hsieh Kung Chian），杜贝伊路（Ave. Dubail）福嘉隆85号。
3. 胡慶塘（Hu Keng Tang），蒙蒂尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）中和里14号。
目前未参与任何政治活动。然而，正在对其进行监视以核实其活动。

page_data.en:
APPENDIX NO. I
Statement of King Chien Ming (金鑑明)
I am the son of the late General King Han Ting (金漢鼎),
former Commander of the 9th Army and ex-Tupan of the Yunnan
Defence Corps. My name is King Chien Ming (金鑑明), age 30,
native of Yunnan. I received my diploma from the Kwenmir (Yun-
nanfu) School of Medicine. In 1931 I came to Shanghai where I
was engaged as assistant-surgeon by the Management of the Hung
Chwang (鴻章紗廠) Cotton Mill, 381 Markham Road. In 1936 I left
this position and returned to my native town. Returning to
Shanghai in July 1937, I was engaged, from the start of the War,
as a lecturer to a stretcher-bearer training course, organized
by the Shanghai Women's Committee (上海婦女慰勞會) of which Madam.
Ho Hsiang Ning (何香凝) was president. Through this Committee,
I joined the "National Salvation Cultural Circles' Federation"
(文化界救國會), by which I was instructed to organize a group
of stretcher-bearers for helping soldiers wounded at the front.
Following the fall of Shanghai, the Federation was dissolved and
the leaders left for the interior. I then commenced working
for the "Mei Jih I Pao" (News Digest), and "Unity". The latter
is published secretly by members of the National Salvation Feder-
ation. I know neither the location of the office nor the editor.
My reports were sent to the editor through the agency of the
person distributing the paper who often came to my home and who
gave me copies which I later sold. In addition to "Unity", the
Kuomintang secretly publishes two other magazines in Shanghai.
They are "Hong Tao" (Bombardment), (轟炸) and "Kio Teu (
Decisive Struggle), (決鬥). I do not know the address of
the office concerned. Since October 1937, I have also collected
subscriptions for the "Gui Guo Sh Pao" (To the Country's Help),
(救國時報), organ of the National Salvation Federation, edited
in Paris. I handed the subscriptions to one Chien Ching Jui (錢俊瑞)
Chief of the Organization Bureau of the National Salvation As
and he, in turn, transmitted them to Mme. Ho Hsiang Ning.

·⑦397
page_data.zh:
附录一
金鑑明（King Chien Ming）供词
我是前第九军军长兼云南护国军督军金漢鼎（King Han Ting）将军之子。我叫金鑑明（King Chien Ming），30岁，云南人。我毕业于昆明（云南府）医学院。1931年我来到上海，受雇于马克姆路（Markham Road）381号鸿章纱厂管理处担任助理外科医生。1936年我离职返回家乡。1937年7月回到上海后，自战争爆发伊始，我便受聘于由何香凝（Ho Hsiang Ning）夫人任主席的上海妇女慰劳会组织的担架员训练班，担任讲师。通过该委员会，我加入了“文化界救国会”，该会指示我组织一个担架员小组，以援助前线受伤的士兵。
上海沦陷后，救国会解散，领导人前往内地。随后我开始为《每日译报》（Mei Jih I Pao）和《团结》工作。后者由救国会成员秘密出版。我既不知道办公室地点，也不知道编辑是谁。我的稿件通过分发报纸的人转交给编辑，此人常来我家，并给我一些样刊，我随后将其出售。除了《团结》，国民党还在上海秘密出版另外两种杂志。它们是《轰炸》（Hong Tao）和《决斗》（Kio Teu）。我不知道相关办公室的地址。自1937年10月以来，我还为救国会的机关报《救国时报》（Gui Guo Sh Pao）收集订阅费，该报在巴黎编辑。我将订阅费交给救国会组织部部长钱俊瑞（Chien Ching Jui），他再将其转交给何香凝夫人。

·⑦397

page_data.en:
- 2 -

of Dr. Liao Chung Kai (廖仲凱) and an intimate friend of
 Mme. Sun Yat-sen. Chien Ching Jui left Shanghai for Hankow
 in February 1938.

According to information in my possession, a number
of youthful members of the National Salvation Federation are
now carrying out a propaganda campaign in Refugee Camps on
behalf of the Federation. Some of them belong to the Trotsky
Clique. This group is said to have formed recently in Shanghai
a secret organization under the name of "Great Youth League to
Save the Country from Annexation". (青年救亡大同盟). The
members of this organization are said to be disseminating
propaganda in schools, factories and refugee camps. Their act-
ivities are directed by Pang Cheh Tse (彭述之), Wang Tu Tsing
(王獨青), Chang Yi (張儀) and Wang Pi Yao (王碧瑤)
who are all in Shanghai.

As to me, my sympathies are with the Chinese Communist
Party (Stalin Group). The activities of the party being kept
secret in Shanghai, I have been unable to join up to the present.

Since May 1938, I have been living at No. 1, Rue Massenet
with one Hsia Shou Tien (謝壽天), an employee of the "Tien Yi"
(天一保險公司) Insurance Company. The latter is a member of the
Shanghai Insurance Companies' Employees' Friendly Society". (上海市保
險業職員聯誼會).

Interrogated on the subject of a list of members of the
"Mutual Aid Society of Residents of various Alleyways" (上海市里弄住
戶互助會), found among the papers seized at his home, King
stated that this Society was established by the National Salvation
Federation at the start of hostilities. Its object was to seek out
Japanese "traitors", organize a boycottage of Japanese merchandise
...... This Society was dissolved after the Chinese troops re-
treated from Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

廖仲凱（Liao Chung Kai）博士之……及孙逸仙夫人的密友。钱俊瑞于1938年2月离开上海前往汉口。

据我所知，救国会的一些年轻成员目前正在难民营中为该会进行宣传活动。其中一些人属于托洛茨基派系。据说该派系最近在上海成立了一个名为“青年救亡大同盟”的秘密组织。据称，该组织成员在学校、工厂和难民营中散布宣传。他们的活动由彭述之（Pang Cheh Tse）、王獨青（Wang Tu Tsing）、張儀（Chang Yi）和王碧瑤（Wang Pi Yao）指导，这些人都在上海。

至于我，我同情中国共产党（斯大林派）。由于该党在上海的活动保持秘密，我至今未能加入。

自1938年5月以来，我一直与谢壽天（Hsia Shou Tien）住在马斯南路（Rue Massenet）1号，他是“天一保险公司”（Tien Yi Insurance Company）的职员。后者是“上海市保险业职员联谊会”的成员。

当被问及在其家中搜获的文件中发现的“上海市里弄住户互助会”成员名单一事时，金表示，该会是由救国会在战事初期建立的。其目的是搜寻日本“汉奸”，组织抵制日货 ____ 该会在中国军队从上海撤退后解散。

page_data.en:
APPENDIX NO. II
Letter from Zao Yen ( 言 )

My dear Lan Fou ( 蘭甫 ),

One of my friends sent me a copy of "National Sal-
vation Youth", ( 救亡青年 ), organ of the Trotsky Group. He
asks if, according to my way of thinking, Trotskyites are traitors
and whether they betray our country to the enemy (that is
Japan). I beg you to reflect calmly on this subject. It is
understood that you do not consider me as a trotskyite. I
have never belonged to any party or group; I am a simple
acolyte of "neo. liberalism." I read the National Salvation
Youth' as well as the "New Digest" (Pro-Communist organ). I
also greatly admire the qualities of Peng Cheh Tse ( 彭述之 )
and of Li Chi ( 李季 ) ( Trotskyites ) rather than the
courage of Ling Piao ( 林彪 ) and Mao Tse Tung ( 毛澤東 ),
leaders of the Chinese Communist Party. Without taking sides,
I uphold their activities as much as they are directed in favour
of the war of resistance.

Dear Lan Fou, you say the Trotskyites are betraying
the country and that they are working for the enemy. But if
you read the works of contemporary authors such as Romain Rolland,
Einstein, etc.........., you will see that they approve of the
policies of the Trotskyites and blame Stalin and the G.P.U.
for their policy of terrorizing the members of the party. Are
these writers who declare themselves in favour of the Trotskyites
to be regarded as having been corrupted by them? Do they know
how things are less well than you? Do not forget the number of
Trotskyites who have been exiled and their children executed by
the G.P.U. At present, everybody, suspected of Trotskyism, is
either imprisoned or executed. Can Moscow leaders, whatever
their real intentions, justify themselves in the eyes of honest
men? Do not believe that I have been won over by Trotskyist
propaganda. I am in favour of justice, humanity and morality. I
am indignant that Trotskyites should be accused of treason.
page_data.zh:
附录二
鮑言（Zao Yen）的信

亲爱的兰甫（Lan Fou）：

一位朋友寄给我一份《救亡青年》，这是托洛茨基派的机关报。他问，按照我的想法，托派是否是叛徒，他们是否出卖国家给敌人（即日本）。我请你冷静地思考这个问题。想必你不认为我是托派。我从未属于任何政党或团体；我只是“新自由主义”的一名简单追随者。我阅读《救亡青年》以及《新文摘》（亲共机关报）。我也非常钦佩彭述之（Peng Cheh Tse）和李季（Li Chi）（托派）的品质，而不是中国共产党领导人林彪（Ling Piao）和毛泽东（Mao Tse Tung）的勇气。在不偏袒任何一方的情况下，只要他们的活动有利于抗战，我就支持他们。

亲爱的兰甫，你说托派出卖国家，为敌人工作。但是，如果你阅读罗曼·罗兰、爱因斯坦等当代作家的作品，你会看到他们赞成托派的政策，并谴责斯大林和国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）恐怖化党员的政策。这些宣称支持托派的作家是否应被视为被他们腐蚀了？难道他们比你更不了解情况吗？不要忘记被流放的托派人数以及被国家政治保卫局处决的他们的子女。目前，所有涉嫌托派主义的人要么被监禁，要么被处决。无论莫斯科领导人的真实意图如何，他们能在正直人士眼中为自己辩解吗？不要相信我被托派宣传所收买。我主张正义、人道和道德。我对托派被指控叛国感到愤慨。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

As for you, our eyes are clouded by Moscow fogs. The day
when they open, you will adopt the ideas that I have just
exposed to you.

Dear Lan, do not be proud of your sentiments.
Reflect! Where is the proof confirming the treacherous act-
ivities of the Trotskyites? Although Chang Mou Tao (張慕陶)
and Huang Kung Tu (黃公度) are Trotskyites, do not consider
them as the only representatives of this group. If Trotskyites
are traitors, then why are their leader Chen Tu Hsiu (陳獨秀)
not arrested by the Government and why do they not go to Nanking
to secure good positions? On the contrary, they have joined
the popular front movement and are working for National Salvation.
You, like me, are not a member of any group. Why, then, do you
speak evilly of the Trotskyites? My child, your friend does not
wish to leave you in obscurity. He wishes to give you a little
light, opening the window of the room in which you are.

Zao Yen (紹言).
Mid-night, the 20th.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

至于你，我们的眼睛被莫斯科的迷雾所遮蔽。当它们睁开时，你将采纳我刚才向你阐述的观点。

亲爱的兰，不要为你的情感感到骄傲。
反思！有什么证据证实托派的叛国活动？虽然张慕陶（Chang Mou Tao）和黄公度（Huang Kung Tu）是托派，但不要认为他们是该团体的唯一代表。如果托派是叛徒，那么为什么他们的领袖陈独秀（Chen Tu Hsiu）没有被政府逮捕，为什么他们不去南京谋取好职位？相反，他们加入了人民阵线运动，并为救国而工作。你和我一样，不属于任何团体。那么，你为什么恶语中伤托派呢？我的孩子，你的朋友不希望让你处于蒙昧之中。他希望给你一点光明，打开你所在房间的窗户。

紹言（Zao Yen）。
20日午夜。
